claim: <One or two sentences quoting only this run's output: the image hash matched SHA256SUMS and DistributionInfo.json, the install and the first launch exited 0, cloud-init created <WSL_USER> (uid 1000) as the default user, and F1-F3 printed running, Linger yes and a user-owned bus socket.>
limitations: One run on one Windows host: a new distribution on the existing WSL kernel and Windows installation, not a new physical machine.
Stage 1 and first boot only: stage 2 (the bootstrap), native sign-in, services and the Windows Terminal PATH proof are not covered.
Sanitized: Windows and Linux user names, home and profile paths and the checkout path are replaced by placeholders; the raw transcript stays private on the host.
jcodemunch_registration records F11's state only: a registration is not evidence that a session or subagent uses jCodeMunch.

recipe.catalog_revision: <F7: git rev-parse HEAD of the new clone>

host.default_distribution_after: <starred line in W5; equal to the line above>

first_launch.user_prompt_marker: <true when the W5 output contains 'Create a default Unix user account:'>
first_launch.oobe_failed_marker: <true when it contains 'OOBE command "/usr/lib/wsl/wsl-setup" failed, exiting'>

subordinate_ids: <F5: the /etc/subuid and /etc/subgid lines, and whether useradd or usermod wrote them>
jcodemunch_registration: <F11: registered (the scope and command lines of claude mcp get jcodemunch), not installed (test -x exited 1), or skipped with the reason>
